full_judgment: 4. In the other case, Ramna PS Case No.53 (2)/91 (DAB GR Case No. 13/91) the gist of the allegation made in the FIR was that the appellant as the then Minister of Works dishonestly and fraudulently released a property at 144 Shanti Nagar; Dhaka from the list of Abandoned Property in favour of one M/s Property Development by abusing his official position and power and thereby caused a loss of Tk. 45,00,000'00 to the Government and thus committed offence under sections 409/420 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of Act II of 1947.
